name: Hallowed Mirror
text: Limit 1 per deck. After this enters play, add 1 Soothing Melody from your bonded cards to your hand and shuffle up to 2 more into your deck. When this leaves play, set those copies aside.

name: Soothing Melody
text: Bonded (Hallowed Mirror). Heal up to 2 damage or horror in any combination from your investigator or Ally assets at your location. Draw 1 card.

name: Occult Lexicon
text: Limit 1 per deck. After this enters play, add 1 Blood-Rite from your bonded cards to your hand and shuffle up to 2 more into your deck. When this leaves play, set those copies aside.

name: Blood-Rite
text: Bonded (Occult Lexicon). Draw 2 cards. Discard up to 2 cards from your hand. For each discarded card, gain 1 resource or spend 1 resource to deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
